valuationPolicy.growthSource: Robust quarterly sustainable growth when available; legacy normalized growth otherwise.
valuationPolicy.principle: Sector-aware evidence weighting; market price is QC guard only, never valuation target.
valuationPolicy.marketAnchorPolicy: Market price is not a valuation target. Distance to market is reviewed only after fundamental model construction.
valuationPolicy.consensus: One consensus vote per independent family; cross-family disagreement is preserved as uncertainty.
